name: bizos-company-os
description: BIZOS — Business Operating System: 19 screens (Dashboard, Org chart, KPI Tree, Operations, Compensation, Finance, OKR, Forecast, Reports, Alerts, Approvals, Audit, Recruiting, Knowledge) built with Next.js 16 + Supabase. Demo mode works without any config.

paragraphs: 🇬🇧 EN · Company OS: Task → personal KPI → team KPI → company KPI → Financials. A Next.js + Supabase business-operating system — 19 production-grade screens, KPI cascade, compensation rule engine, P&L/BS/CF, what-if Forecast, OKRs, Audit, SOPs. 🇻🇳 VI · Hệ thống vận hành công ty: Task → KPI cá nhân → KPI phòng ban → KPI công ty → Tài chính. Live demo: bizos-company-os.vercel.app — browse all 19 screens in Demo mode even without Supabase. Toggle VI / EN from the top bar. 📘 Guide / Hướng dẫn: /guide — full walkthrough of all 19 screens + 3 end-to-end workflows + tips.
by Alex Le · alexle@titanlabs.vn Donate: PayPal — sai211dn@gmail.com Need a custom deployment? Email alexle@titanlabs.vn (VN/EN welcomed).
